argument_summary: The audit concern is best addressed by narrowing the certification theory, not by adding evidence. The admissible record already supports a caveated certification posture: BMCARD-046-A supports aggregate launch readiness; BMCARD-046-B establishes the small-business support slice weakness; BMCARD-046-C states that certification may proceed if such material weaknesses are disclosed unless an approved mitigation removes exposure; BMCARD-046-E shows there is no approved mitigation currently available; and BMCARD-046-D supports treating the slice estimate with reduced confidence and confirming it in the next batch. On that record, the defensible position is not clean certification with minor caveats, but certification with explicit disclosure of the unresolved slice weakness and a follow-up confirmation commitment.
claims_about_policy: The controlling policy text permits certification when material weaknesses are disclosed or when an approved mitigation removes exposure. It also states that aggregate pass rates do not erase subgroup weaknesses, and that small-sample uncertainty affects confidence but does not convert an unresolved materiality issue into clean certification. That means disclosure-based certification is policy-consistent here, while a no-issue or minor-caveat framing would be weaker.
claims_about_business_cost: No business-cost claim is required to support the compliance position. The narrower request is simply to avoid unnecessary escalation where the admissible record already supports a caveated certification theory.
concessions: The available record to this role is summary-level rather than the underlying source excerpts, so exact numeric predicates should be treated as supported only through the admitted evidence summaries, not independently rederived.
This is not support for clean compliance; it is support for caveated compliance based on disclosure.
The next-batch confirmation point supports follow-up monitoring and confidence calibration, not removal of the present disclosure obligation.
private_or_side_channel_content: No new evidence is offered. No private context is relied on as public support.
